messages:
sara: P1 — AcmeChat reporting ~30% of requests returning 401 after we rotated their API key at 09:18 UTC. Started seeing alerts at 09:23. Customer says retries sometimes succeed.

jamie: On it. Do we know where the client is running?

acme_ops: They run a fleet of Windows Server containers behind our eu-west edge. We rotate keys via Vault + KMS, then update env vars in the container through our deploy agent.

mike: Quick hypothesis: Windows service doesn't HUP envs; file-based env injection might require process restart. Are the containers getting restarted?

acme_ops: Agent logs show CONFIG_APPLY succeeded, but no container restarts. We rely on sidecar to write env and send SIGHUP — Windows containers ignore that.

irene: That matches an earlier bug (windows-hup-notice) — Windows sidecars wrote to env file but didn't restart the service. Some requests used cached token in memory leading to intermittent auth.

sara: Customer says some clients (mobile) immediately picked up new key, web apps kept failing. We need repro steps and mitigation ASAP.

mike: Repro steps I ran on a lab Windows container:
```
# write rotated key to env file
echo API_KEY=new-rotated-key > C:\app\envvars\apikey.env
# sidecar writes file but does not restart main.exe
# verify main.exe still has old env in process memory
tasklist /v | findstr main.exe
# use ProcMon / SysInternals to confirm no restart
```
Result: main.exe still serving requests with in-memory old key -> 401 from edge after backend rejects old key.

jamie: Short-term mitigation: trigger a graceful restart of the app process after rotation for Windows containers. For customers on Dedicated/Private we can auto-enqueue a restart job.

irene: Longer-term: change sidecar to support Windows service control manager (sc stop/start) / use the process manager to reload env. Also add a rotation healthcheck that verifies token accepted by auth proxy and falls back to rollback if not.

acme_ops: For AcmeChat we can run a one-off restart. They asked for rollback to previous key while we patch. Do we have previous key retained?

vault-bot: Note: Vault policy retains previous active version for 24h. Rewind operation allowed for authorised ops-role. Use: `vault kv get -version=1 secret/apikeys/acmechat`

mike: Ops, please execute rollback to previous key and coordinate 1m maintenance. Also add a loggable marker to the rotation job so we can trace which containers applied new env file but didn't restart.

sara: I'll message the customer: propose immediate rollback + scheduled restart + ETA for patch.

acme_ops: Rolled back to previous key at 09:40 UTC and restarted containers (orchestrator restart). Errors dropped to 0 by 09:44. Customer confirmed recovery.

jamie: Follow-ups: (1) Patch sidecar for Windows restart paths, (2) add rotation verification step that does a test auth after key swap, (3) update KB with explicit Windows guidance.

sara: Adding postmortem checklist items into support ticket and tagging eng-runtime. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

mike: Filed ENG-RUNTIME ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/3278 — includes repro, logs, and suggested patch.

irene: I'll schedule a canary patch for next week and add regression test covering env-only key swaps.

sara: Closing P1 after customer confirms stable. Will follow up with PM to ensure KB visibility.
